reproduction.inputs: All seventeen report_base pairs at recorded SHA-256 identities; no source contents required.
steps: Expand every primary_decoder to exact source paths. Reject non-relative/traversal paths; normalize separators and dot directory markers without resolving symlinks.
Retain owner sets and detect duplicates before taking the union. Ignore targets, consumer/reference lists, globs and supplemental ignored evidence when enumerating primary ownership.
Apply denominator exclusions to primary paths. Remaining set is recorded product/support footprint; inspect depths remain partition-specific facts, not accepted coverage.
For a new labeled observation, deduplicate NUL-separated current cached and nonignored untracked names. Apply the same denominator exclusions. Do not reread any source body.
Compute current minus recorded for deltas; match assigned_roots by exact root or slash-prefixed descendant and A16 direct_root_files_assigned for top-level files only. Root match never grants review.

Emit exact delta names, root gaps, collisions and non-following stat limitations. Recompute filename-set hashes with the recorded encoding. Never sum incompatible historical counts or promote metadata/static scans to behavioral acceptance.
reproduction.semantic_review_limitation: Complete reads are model/source-text observations at each return's stated basis. Most rows are lexical/static or metadata/excluded; runtime/bundler/compiler closure, current authority/resources/SQL/native settlement, physical lifecycles, same-listener packaged deployment and mounted UI parity remain unverified or held. No global all-file behavioral-review percentage is asserted.
